prompts.title: From Blank Hallway to Luxe Feature Wall
prompts.prompt_text:
Develop a single‑image post for the First‑Time Home Buyer persona (22‑35, Ahmedabad). The image must show a stark before‑and‑after comparison of a hallway, using a split‑screen layout that is visually striking without any overlaid text. The left side displays the bland, white‑wall hallway; the right side reveals the same space after applying a bold vertical‑stripe wallpaper, subtle LED accent lighting, and a small decorative runner rug. The caption follows a before‑after hook, lists three concrete design steps, and ends with a CTA inviting DMs with "AD" for a free spec concept. Use the brand’s educational tone and include eight hashtags mixing hyper‑niche, industry, and broad discovery tags. This post targets saves and profile visits by offering a clear, replicable makeover blueprint.

Visual deliverable: create exactly one finished static image, with the complete composition in a single frame.
prompts.caption:
See how a dull hallway becomes a luxe feature in 3 steps

🟢 Step 1: Choose a bold, vertically‑striped wallpaper that adds height.
🟢 Step 2: Apply our zero‑damage paste technique—no wall damage, easy removal.
🟢 Step 3: Add simple LED strip lighting to highlight the pattern.

The transformation is instant, budget‑friendly, and perfect for first‑time home buyers.

💌 Want a spec concept for your own space? DM "AD" with your brief and we’ll design the look.

#HallwayMakeover #BeforeAfter #WallpaperDIY #InteriorDesignIndia #DIYTips #HomeMakeover #BudgetRenovation #EcoFriendlyLiving
